determinism.method: Two same-input runs of build_cards_w4file.py compared by digest: md5sum over the 21 delivered cards, re-run the generator unchanged, md5sum again, diff the two sorted digest sets. Plus a negative control on the comparator itself -- a 1-byte append to one card must change its digest.
determinism.observed: STABLE. 21 of 21 cards byte-identical across the two runs. NEGATIVE CONTROL FIRED: the 1-byte append changed the digest, so the comparator can detect a difference and a match is meaningful. Determinism is by construction -- as_of is bound ONCE as a literal and every count is derived from probe JSON captured before the build, so there is no clock read or HEAD read at build time to drift. That is the same property AC6 depends on: a wave pin that re-derived itself per card could not be byte-identical across 21.
